svg.text: A4 landscape | 2 / 3 | Named nets connect across sheets | NC = intentionally unused pin

text.tspan: U_MCU / CH32X035 controls USB and STEP/DIR.
Internal clock avoids an external crystal.

svg.text: U_ESD / USBLC6 protects D+/D-. R_CC1/2 identify a USB sink.

text.tspan: Q_DATA / MMBT3904 senses host 5 V without a direct GPIO feed.
WCH debug pads and USB boot strap.
